prompt:
Use only the following information:
• Every finalised case has a signed approval.
• A case may be billed only after it is finalised.
• Case 284 was billed.
• No signed approval is recorded for Case 284.

Which conclusion is best supported?

options.B: The invoice for Case 284 must be cancelled.
options.C: At least one record or required process step relating to Case 284 is inconsistent.
options.D: The signed approval was probably lost.

prompt: Consultant X billed 31 hours last week and Consultant Y billed 38 hours. A manager wants to conclude that Y was more productive. Which additional information is most important before drawing that conclusion?

options.C: Their available client-working hours and the complexity/type of work assigned.

prompt:
A policy states:
• If a change affects taxable remuneration, payroll review is required.
• If payroll review identifies a change above R5,000, manager approval is also required.

A proposed change is R7,500 but does not affect taxable remuneration. What follows from the rules alone?

options.A: Payroll review and manager approval are required.
options.B: Manager approval is required but payroll review is not.
options.C: Neither requirement can be concluded from these rules.
options.D: Payroll review is required but manager approval is not.

prompt:
You start at 09:00.
• Task A takes 30 minutes and must be completed before Task B can start.
• Task B takes 20 minutes and is due at 10:15.
• Task C takes 25 minutes and is due at 09:40.
• Task D takes 15 minutes and is due at 10:30.

Which sequence completes all four on time?

Each row should satisfy: Opening + Additions − Reductions = Closing. Exactly one row is inconsistent.

A: 120 + 35 − 15 = 140
B: 90 + 28 − 13 = 105
C: 150 + 45 − 20 = 175
D: 80 + 42 − 17 = 115

Which row is inconsistent?

A document-control rule states:
• Any external document containing personal data requires privacy approval.
• If that external document is also marked Confidential, department-manager approval is required in addition.
• Internal documents do not require privacy approval under this rule.

A Confidential document containing personal data will be sent to an external recipient. What is required?

options.D: Neither approval if the recipient already knows the information.

prompt: A department introduces a checklist and claims it reduced errors. Which evidence would give the strongest support for that conclusion?

options.A: Staff say the checklist feels helpful.
options.B: There were fewer errors in the week after launch than in the week before launch.
options.C: The department manager reports that people are paying more attention.
options.D: Error rates are compared before and after introduction over comparable periods, with workload volume considered and a similar department without the checklist used as a comparison where possible.

prompt: Only the latest approved version of a procedure may be issued. Version 3 was approved on Monday. Version 4 was drafted Tuesday and rejected Wednesday. Version 5 was drafted Thursday but has not yet been approved. Which version may be issued on Friday?

A priority rule states:
• Priority 1: financial impact affecting more than 10 people and due within 2 hours.
• Priority 2: a client issue with a deadline today.
• Priority 3: internal requests due after today.

At 10:00 you have:
A. Payroll issue affecting 8 people, due 11:00.
B. Payroll issue affecting 12 people, due 11:30.
C. Client issue due 17:00 today.
D. Internal board-deck request due tomorrow.

Which item has the highest priority under the stated rule?
A team recorded 10 errors across 100 transactions in May and 12 errors across 200 transactions in June. Which statement is most accurate?

options.A: Performance worsened because there were more errors in June.
options.B: The number of errors increased, but the error rate decreased from 10% to 6%.
options.C: The error rate increased because 12 is greater than 10.
options.D: No comparison is possible because the transaction totals are different.

prompt: Supplier A had 20 defects in 1,000 units last quarter. Supplier B had 1 defect in 10 units. Which conclusion is most defensible?

options.A: Supplier B is clearly better because it had fewer defects.
options.B: Supplier A is clearly better because its observed defect rate is lower, although the sample sizes are very different.
options.C: Supplier B is clearly worse because 10% is always unacceptable.
options.D: The suppliers are equally reliable because both had defects.

prompt: A ticket can be closed only if either (1) client confirmation is recorded, or (2) the field confirmation_not_required is set to true. Ticket 715 is closed and no client confirmation is recorded. Assuming the records are accurate, what must be true?

options.D: The ticket was probably an internal request.

prompt: A company wants to know whether a new training programme reduced turnaround time. Which comparison would provide the strongest practical evidence?

options.A: Ask trained employees whether they feel faster.
options.B: Compare turnaround before and after training for the trained group, and where possible compare the same period with a similar untrained group while considering workload mix.
options.C: Compare the fastest trained employee with the fastest untrained employee.
options.D: Compare this month’s turnaround with the company’s best month last year.

prompt:
Three tasks must each be assigned to one different person.
• Task F requires Finance skill.
• Task C requires Client skill and the client specifically requested Amy.
• Task S requires Systems skill.

Amy: Finance + Client
Ben: Client + Systems
Cara: Finance + Systems

Which assignment satisfies all constraints?

Use only the following statements:
• Every manager can approve leave.
• Some team leaders are managers.
• No contractor is a manager.

Which conclusion must be true?

options.A: Every team leader can approve leave.
options.B: Some team leaders can approve leave.
